injection.mechanism: Jinja chat_template parses {REASON:<mode>} in the last tagged user message, strips the tag, injects mode-specific system directives before thinking/generation. Instruct forms use leading i (e.g. icoder). AGI forms merge two+ constructs: agi-a-b or iagi-a-b.
injection.public_xhigh_steering: Reasoning effort is set to xhigh. Please think carefully through the task, validate key assumptions, consider plausible alternatives, and prioritize correctness, consistency, and clarity in the final answer.
injection.public_low_steering: Reasoning effort is set to low. Keep your thinking brief and focused, moving directly to the conclusion without unnecessary elaboration.
injection.note: Full multi-k-token AI/AGI construct bodies live in copyrighted chat_template.jinja (David Belton / DavidAU 2026). Do not redistribute verbatim. This catalog keeps public help-menu short descriptions only.

behavior.lm_studio: Load GGUF with embedded Turbo Brilliance template (or swap chat template). Local OpenAI API usually http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1. Probe with {REASON:help}.
